push.title: W 5-4 vs Blitz FC | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #9)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 10.0. Perfect Game #9. I've been coaching a long time and I still got goosebumps.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 9th Perfect Game for us. More of that, please and thank you.
+ 6 shots at Blitz FC's goal. You weren't shy, and shy doesn't score.
+ 1 key pass. Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ Man of the Match, your 19th for us. When you play like that, the whole team stands taller.
+ This was the win that got us promoted out of Division 4. Team wins are the best kind.

THE BAD
- 2 of 6 shots on target. Low-hanging fruit: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. We'll get there together.
- 2 tackles won: -0.2. Low-hanging fruit.
- Pass accuracy: 81%. Top forwards reach 88%+. You've got the legs for it.

Back-garden drill: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.

PhogsToffees, write this on your hand if you have to: Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

Same time, same energy, next match. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 5-4 vs Blitz FC | You: 9.2
push.body:
buddskees, a 9.2 against Blitz FC. If football were a garden, you'd be the tomatoes.

THE GOOD
+ Shots 7, up from your usual 1. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ 88% passing on 17 attempts, up from your usual 69%. Tidier than my mama's guest bathroom.
+ 1 key pass. You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ This was the win that got us promoted out of Division 4. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.
+ PhogsToffees finished what you started. That's teamwork.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Habit to build: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts. You've got this.
- You and BellyTb1, same defensive work rate homework. Partners: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Lowest shot accuracy on the team: 29% (best was BellyTb1's 83%). Honest truth: that cost us.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 17 (best was PhogsToffees's 32). Lesson of the day: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.
- 4 goals conceded took 0.1. Head up first, then play.

Practice this: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.

buddskees, one more thing before you log off: You're not behind; you're just early to your comeback.

Smile; you earned it. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 5-4 vs Blitz FC | You: 8.5
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.5. That's what showing up looks like, and it looks good on you.

THE GOOD
+ 29 passes (up from your usual 18). You showed for it every time. That's courage.
+ A goal against Blitz FC. Goals change games, and you changed this one.
+ 1 key pass. You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ This was the win that got us promoted out of Division 4. That's a team that believes in itself.
+ PhogsToffees scored, but that goal had your name in the credits.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Here's the fix: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- 69% passing (20 of 29). Here's what helps: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle. Clean it up and fly.
- 1 goal from 5 on target. Here's how: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket. Easy as pie.
- Team project for you and buddskees: defensive work rate. The plan: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 8.5 (best was PhogsToffees's 10.0). Not who you are, but it was who showed up.

Before next match: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

Remember, BellyTb1: Doubt is a guest. Don't give it the spare room.

Hold onto this feeling. - Coach Lasso
